summary: Day 16 testing complete — Dethrone 'Heart Attack' Nudge (Web Push + In-app) feature fully tested. All 73 backend tests pass (Day 13-16 combined). Frontend verified with Playwright: PushOptInButton visible on /case, DethroneBanner component mounted, service worker has push handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: VAPID keys properly configured in backend/.env — public key starts with 'B' (uncompressed EC point), ~88 chars
GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns {vapid_public_key, enabled: true} — public endpoint
POST /api/push/subscribe requires auth, accepts {endpoint, keys: {p256dh, auth}, user_agent}, idempotent upsert by (user_id, endpoint)
POST /api/push/unsubscribe requires auth, accepts {endpoint}, returns {unsubscribed: true|false}
GET /api/notifications requires auth (401 without), returns {notifications: [...], unread_count: N}, supports only_unread=true and limit params
POST /api/notifications/{id}/read requires auth, marks notification read, 404 if not found or belongs to another user
POST /api/notifications/read-all requires auth, marks all user's notifications read, returns {updated: N}
services/dethrone.py check_for_dethrone() called after successful upvote in routes/social.py line ~285-290
Dethrone notification body matches verbatim: 'You just lost the crown to @USERNAME. Beat them by Sunday or it's their Pro extension! 👑'
crown_state collection tracks weekly #1 holder, bootstraps on first vote of week without firing notification
Service worker /sw.js has 'push' and 'notificationclick' event handlers (verified via GET /sw.js)
Frontend DethroneBanner component polls /api/notifications every 60s, shows red gradient banner on dethrone notification
Frontend PushOptInButton visible on /case page next to ADD A PACK button (data-testid='push-opt-in-btn' or 'push-status-granted')
Anonymous users on /case see login prompt, no PushOptInButton or DethroneBanner visible
Regression: Battle CTA, privacy enforcement, thumbs voting, subscription endpoints all working
test_credentials: admin@flipnrip.com / AdminPass123! (role='admin' set in db.users, email in ADMIN_EMAILS env var)
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_dethrone_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 16 Dethrone 'Heart Attack' Nudge feature fully tested: (1) VAPID keys configured and working — GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns valid key starting with 'B'. (2) Push subscribe/unsubscribe endpoints require auth, idempotent upsert. (3) Notifications API: GET /api/notifications (auth required, supports only_unread + limit), POST /api/notifications/{id}/read (404 for wrong user), POST /api/notifications/read-all. (4) Dethrone detection: services/dethrone.py check_for_dethrone() called after upvote, compares weekly top-1 vs crown_state, fires notification on change with verbatim copy. (5) Service worker has push + notificationclick handlers. (6) Frontend: DethroneBanner polls notifications, PushOptInButton on /case page. (7) All 73 backend tests pass (Day 13-16). Note: Web Push fan-out to real endpoints not tested (no real browser subscriptions in test env) — in-app notification creation verified.
